The '''Seraphan system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the company known as [[Seraphan Industries]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|323|Webble, Illyan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Seraphan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-10.<ref name="TEA" />
